messages:
alex_cheng: Heads-up — planning a short write-fence for the payments schema change tonight. Target window 23:00-23:20 UTC. Need an owner for smoke checks + rollback prep. Who can take?

maria_gonzalez: I can own smoke checks. Will run the schema preflight and quick reads against replicas.

alex_cheng: thanks maria. can you also validate replica lag and that the consumer service can tolerate a short read-only period?

maria_gonzalez: yup. plan: 22:40 warm replicas, 22:50 run healthcheck script, 22:55 take read-only fence, 23:00 apply migration, 23:05 quick smoke queries, 23:15 lift fence if ok. I'll paste the healthcheck commands in a sec.

danny_k: i'll be on call for rollback and can stand by for traffic switch. what's the expected backfill size?

maria_gonzalez: backfill is tiny — ~3k rows, should complete <5m. main risk is consumer write attempts during fence, so need feature-flag gating at 23:00.

alex_cheng: feature-flag gating noted. ops_bot, pls reserve the slot and attach the migration ID to the deploy ticket.

ops_bot: Slot reserved: 2024-11-08 23:00 UTC. Migration ID: m20241108_payments_v2. Ticket: INF-4321.

maria_gonzalez: healthcheck snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
# run on replica
pg_isready -h payments-replica || exit 1
psql -c "select count(*) from payments where migrated = false;" payments_db
# check replication lag
ssh replica01 "cat /var/lib/postgres/replication_lag"
```

alex_cheng: nice. danny — for rollback plan, if backfill fails or smoke fails, what's the quick path?

danny_k: rollback plan: 1) abort migration job, 2) lift write-fence (feature flag = on), 3) run quick compensating job to revert partial schema toggles (script ready at infra repo). I can execute step 2 and 3 within 5-10m.

maria_gonzalez: addition: if replica lag > 5s at 22:55 we delay by 10m. I will post lag numbers by 22:55.

alex_cheng: good. can someone sanity-check permissions? migration will need schema apply role and backfill runner role. ops_bot, confirm service accounts attached to INF-4321.

ops_bot: INF-4321 metadata updated: deployer: ci-runner, schema_role: payments_schema, backfill_role: payments_backfill_runner.

maria_gonzalez: quick note — we should capture smoke query results to the ticket with a small screenshot or paste. will paste results into INF-4321 thread.

alex_cheng: ok final checklist: 
- owner: maria for smoke
- rollback: danny
- ops slot: confirmed
- feature-flag gating: product to flip at 23:00
- healthchecks and replica warmup: maria at 22:40

alex_cheng: if no objections I'll mark this as the runbook and start the countdown at 22:30. :thumbsup:

maria_gonzalez: :thumbsup: all set from my side, will post updates as I run checks.

danny_k: i'll be around, ping me at 22:55 if lag numbers look bad.

sre_oncall_bot: Reminder scheduled: 22:30 UTC — preflight check.

alex_cheng: thanks team.
